name: Aventesma
body:
Aventesma CR 16

This towering humanoid is eerily thin, with huge yellow eyes staring out from its gaunt face and pale ragged garments shrouding its willowy, green-skinned form.

XP 76,800
CN Large fey
Init +2; Senses darkvision 120 ft., see invisibility; Perception +30

DEFENSE

AC 31, touch 15, flat-footed 25 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +16 natural, –1 size)
hp 212 (24d6+120)
Fort +13, Ref +17, Will +15
DR 10/cold iron; Immune charm, compulsion, fear

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee 2 claws +21 (3d12+7/19-20 plus bleed)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks bleed (1d4), locking gaze, nightmare haunting
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 16th; concentration +21)

Constant—see invisibility
At will—dimension door, ethereal jaunt, invisibility
3/day—charm monster (DC 19), dominate person (DC 20)
1/day—feeblemind (DC 20), plane shift (DC 20), shapechange

STATISTICS

Str 25, Dex 20, Con 21, Int 18, Wis 17, Cha 20
Base Atk +12; CMB +20 (+24 trip); CMD 35 (37 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Expertise, Combat Reflexes, Dodge, Greater Trip, Improved Critical (claw), Improved Trip, Mobility, Power Attack, Spring Attack, Tripping Strike, Weapon Focus (claw), Whirlwind Attack
Skills Acrobatics +32, Bluff +32, Diplomacy +32, Knowledge (geography) +31, Knowledge (local) +31, Knowledge (nature) +31, Knowledge (planes) +28, Perception +30, Sense Motive +30, Stealth +28
Languages Aklo, Common, Infernal, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Change Size (Su)

The aventesma can use a standard action to grow larger and more imposing. It becomes larger by one category at a time, going from Large to Huge, and it can use this ability again to grow to Gargantuan size. During this transformation, the reach on its claw attacks increases to 20 feet at Huge size, and then 25 feet at Gargantuan size. While huge, it gains temporary hit points equal to half its hit points. While it is Gargantuan, it gains temporary hit points equal to its current hit points. The transformation lasts for 1 hour, during which time the aventesma gains a +5 bonus on all Strength-based checks and Fortitude saving throws. As a standard action, prior to the end of this ability’s natural duration, it can reduce its size by one category until it is once again Large size. Once it has gone completely through this cycle and has returned to its normal size, it can’t use this ability again until the next day.

Bridge/Gate Formation (Su)

As a standard action, the aventesma can contort its body and form a bridge or gate across a gap, chasm, or other impassable terrain. The bridge can span up to 30 feet in length and 10 feet in width, and it remains in place for up to 1 minute. The bridge can support creatures of any size. Alternatively, the aventesma can form a gate that blocks a passage or entryway up to 30 feet in width and 15 feet in height.

The gate lasts for up to 1 minute.

Locking Gaze (Ex)

Humanoids within 30 feet of the aventesma that look directly at her are paralyzed for 2d4 rounds (DC 27 Will negates), perceiving themselves as being crushed across the threshold of a closing portal. Creatures failing their save take 2d12 points of force damage immediately. Each round at the end of their turn, a paralyzed creature can attempt a new save to escape the aventesma’s locking gaze, taking 2d12 additional points of force damage (DC 27 Will half), ending the paralyzation on a successful save. If a creature successfully saves or the duration expires, they are immune to that aventesma’s locking gaze for 24 hours. An aventesma can suppress or resume this ability as a free action. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Nightmare Haunting (Su)

Once per day, while on the Ethereal Plane, the aventesma magically touches a sleeping humanoid on the Material Plane. A protection spell cast on the target prevents this contact. As long as the contact persists, the target has dreadful visions. If these visions last for at least 1 hour, the target is fatigued when it awakens, gaining no benefit from its rest, and it gains one negative level (DC 27 Will negates).

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

These enormous apparitions resemble enormously tall but eerily thin humans, stretching around 12 feet tall but willowy slender and able to contort itself with disconcerting ease.

Mortal eyes strain to take in their appearance, as they seem to grow the longer one looks at them, eventually seeming to almost merge with the sky or to arch and bend over like a bridge. If this bridge examines, it appears stable and safe to all appearance, as stout as a span of wood or stone. However, the aventesma’s face and twisted limbs remain clearly visible, bent and warped through the substance of the span. The aventesma may allow free passage or it may block those wishing to cross or set them a task or a riddle that must be completed before it allows them through. Even if their terms are met, wise travelers sometimes toss a stone through the arch of the aventesma’s bridge, for if the stone disappears or cannot pass through the archway, they know that eerie fey magic is afoot and they had best find a different path. Aventesma are not inherently malevolent, but meeting one is considered an ill omen and an echoe of stray spirits left behind.
